instruction: Configure the Streamlit framework for building data apps. Clone the repository 'https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit' to /home/user and set up the development environment according to their contributor guidelines.

metadata.explanation: Task variation testing Streamlit framework setup. Evaluator verifies that the streamlit module can be imported and version can be printed without errors. The check_include_exclude metric ensures no error strings appear in output.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires cloning repo to /home/user AND setting up dev environment, but evaluator only checks if streamlit can be imported
Incorrect verification logic: Simply checking 'import streamlit' succeeds does not verify that the development environment was set up according to contributor guidelines
Missing verification: No check that repository was cloned to /home/user
Missing verification: No check that dev environment setup steps were followed (e.g., editable install, dev dependencies)
False positive risk: Evaluator would pass if user just ran 'pip install streamlit' without cloning the repo or setting up dev environment
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to check if /home/user/streamlit directory exists and contains expected repo structure (e.g., .git directory, setup.py, pyproject.toml)
Add getter to verify streamlit is installed in development/editable mode (check if 'pip show streamlit' shows Location pointing to /home/user/streamlit)
Add getter to check if dev dependencies are installed (e.g., check for pytest, mypy, or other dev tools mentioned in contributor guidelines)
Consider using multiple evaluation steps with partial credit: 1) repo cloned to correct location (0.33), 2) dev environment set up (0.33), 3) streamlit importable (0.34)
Alternatively, run 'pip show streamlit' and verify Location field points to /home/user/streamlit to confirm dev install
